judge.voice: I would use it again. It took about seven minutes and the tasks were my kind of work: the sales report, table or chart, small talk with the Dutch colleagues. Nothing childish. B1 feels right, and nobody made me feel stupid. When I wrote "faktura" it just went on. The corrections were useful: "he wants", "safer", "a waste of time". I can use those on Monday. I trust the level mostly. I did not understand why the table-or-chart answer counted as failing when the note said my reasons were clear, and the "may be a little off" line was vague. The next focus, articles, is specific and fair. It is cheaper than a 800 CZK course and quicker than my translator tab. I would tell a colleague. I would like it to go on to presenting the quarter's numbers next.
